bureau: 財團法人金融聯合徵信中心 (Joint Credit Information Center)
note: The Joint Credit Information Center's questions on disclosure periods: a cardholder's payment data is disclosed one year from the payment due date. No source states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: 金融聯合徵信中心, 信用資料揭露期限常見問答
sources.said: 信用卡戶帳款資料揭露期限，繳款資料自繳款截止日起揭露1年
